text:
sasha-recruits: quick heads up - the weekly interviewer availability snapshot export failed for week-of 2024-05-06. panels are showing different avail windows compared to calendar feed. job id: export-1715002468

sasha-recruits: error in logs: ```ERROR: snapshot-checksum-mismatch: expected=8f3a2b got=9b1c7d; affected_rows=12```

devon-ops: is this only for a specific region or all calendars? any recent deploys to the scheduler?

sasha-recruits: looks concentrated in APAC timezones (SG, HKG) from quick scan. no scheduler deploys in last 48h. export job runs daily and weekly snapshot run failed.

ats-bot: Export job export-1715002468 failed - reason: checksum mismatch between snapshot and calendar feed. See logs at https://logs.redwood.internal/export/1715002468 (restricted)

liam-scheduler: my guess: DST/zone normalization edge-case - timezone library bumped and local times normalized differently so checksum changed. quick mitigation: re-run snapshot with --normalize-timezone=UTC and --dedupe-invites flag. e.g.:
```bash
./run_export --job weekly --normalize-timezone=UTC --dedupe-invites --dry-run
```

marie-people-ops: if we re-run, will that create duplicate panel invites for candidates? want to avoid extra emails.

devon-ops: do a dry-run first (no invites) to confirm deltas. then run with --dedupe-invites; all invite payloads include an external id so dedupe should be safe. i'll open a ticket to surface any duplicates if they show up. schedule prod run outside APAC candidate hours - propose 21:00 UTC.

sasha-recruits: running dry-run now, will paste results.

sasha-recruits: dry-run output: "12 changed windows, 9 of them due to timezone offset normalization, 3 due to missing end times" - sample: `panel_id: 8432, old: 2024-05-08T09:00+08:00, new: 2024-05-08T01:00Z`

liam-scheduler: that aligns with the DST normalization theory. good news is dedupe should prevent duplicate invites. please test dedupe on staging.

sasha-recruits: tested on staging with --dedupe-invites, staging run applied fixes and created 0 duplicate invites. going to schedule prod run 2024-05-06 21:00 UTC and monitor. i'll add the run steps + flags to the runbook.

marie-people-ops: add a short note to hiring-managers slack that we may reconcile some avail windows this evening (will not trigger extra emails). cc: @hiring-managers channel

liam-scheduler: also adding a lightweight CI check: assert export snapshot checksum == calendar-feed checksum after normalization; if mismatch, create an alert pager.

devon-ops: filed infra ticket INF-4192 to add metric/export-checksum to our observability dashboard and an alert threshold. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4192

sasha-recruits: thanks - looping in @eng-oncall for the prod window in case anything unexpected pops. i'll post a completion note after the 21:00 run. :thumbsup:

marie-people-ops: thank you. if the prod run results in >5 affected panels we'll do a short postmortem and update the scheduler rollout notes.

sasha-recruits: noted - will report back after run.
